run_figure_gen: run the script to train DQN and SARSA agents on CartPole-v1 and generate a comparison plot
run_moving_average: run the moving_average function to smooth episode return data with a configurable window size
run_online_learning_dqn: run online learning with a PearlAgent using DeepQLearning policy learner and BasicReplayBuffer on CartPole-v1
run_online_learning_sarsa: run online learning with a PearlAgent using DeepSARSA policy learner and SARSAReplayBuffer on CartPole-v1
review_main: review the main function that trains DQN and SARSA agents and saves a comparison figure
